best_for: Families, LAN-party hosts and casual players who want a free kart racer with split-screen on Windows, Mac or Linux.
description:
SuperTuxKart is a free 3D arcade kart racer that has been in the works for over 20 years. Alayan and Sven lead the team today, hundreds of people have helped over the years, and many of the racers are mascots of open source projects, such as Tux the penguin.

In Story mode you race against the villain Nolok and unlock the rest of the game. You can also play Grand Prix cups, chase your best time in Time Trial with no powerups, or survive Follow-the-Leader, an elimination race. Version 1.5 has 21 official tracks and 18 karts in three classes. You grab nine kinds of powerups from gift boxes, and players further back get better ones, so races stay close.

points.title: Online play is down for now
points.text: On October 24, 2026 the team took its online services offline after security flaws hit the add-ons server. New accounts, add-on uploads, password resets and online rankings are unavailable until a rewrite is done. Single-player, split-screen and LAN games still work, and approved add-ons can still be installed.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: SuperTuxKart is free under GPL-3.0 or later. The team is raising USD 4,000 to finish the online rewrite, but nothing in the game is for sale.

points.title: What 1.5 brings
points.text: Version 1.5 is the current stable release and adds soccer fields, egg hunts and a benchmark mode. A larger update, SuperTuxKart Evolution, is in the works with no public test builds yet.

points.title: Builds for almost everything
points.text: Windows gets installers for 32-bit, 64-bit and ARM64 that install for all users. The Mac zip is signed and universal. Linux has tarballs on the official site and a Flatpak that Flathub marks as verified.

points.title: A big download
points.text: The Flatpak is about 741 MB to download and 831 MB installed.

points.title: Few versions kept
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 4 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release.
